rows.text: The Council's history page says King Fahd announced a new Shura Council system in a speech on 27/8/1412 AH, and describes a four-Hijri-year term, a first term of sixty members and a second term of a Chairman and ninety members.
rows.locator: Section on the Shura Council under King Fahd bin Abdulaziz
